products.title: Softee Speed Orange Power Reedition - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE SPEED ORANGE POWER REEDITION - We continue with a special racket, a reissue of the classic Speed, in orange. This racket is powerful thanks to its teardrop format. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Looking for the best offers on padel rackets, the SOFTEE SPEED ORANGE POWER REEDITION is one of those padel rackets that will interest you. This is a very versatile padel racket suitable for all types of players.

PLAYER TYPE

The Speed collection rackets are designed to maximize the power of each hit. Recommended for intermediate-advanced players looking for a little more power in their game.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

In terms of features, it is one of the most complete Softee rackets and at a very good price for all budgets.

We highlight its 3K carbon fiber composition, which will give us that degree of durability and power that we like so much. 3K carbon is performing very well in padel rackets. It is durable and light, also partly improving the mobility of the racket.

It incorporates a soft S8 eva rubber, a Softee Padel rubber with a soft finish that is great for reducing vibrations. If you are looking for a pleasant sensation, this is your racket.

PLAY STYLE

This is a model aimed at the player who wants more power without missing the opportunity to have control. We can say that it will offer us a balanced playing style.

products.title: Softee Winner Star Pro - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE WINNER STAR PRO - The Winner model stands out for its balance and durability thanks to 3K carbon fiber. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SOFTEE WINNER STAR PRO is your next racket if you are looking for good value for money. High-end shovel at a reduced price. Composed of 3K carbon on a smooth surface in black and silver design.

PLAYER TYPE

Recommended to any player. It is a super versatile padel racket perfect for solving the game both from the baseline and from the attack.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

One of the most appreciated features of the Winner range is its ability to provide a fast and effective ball output. This not only increases the power behind each hit, but also improves the player's responsiveness, allowing them to return the ball with confidence and precision.

The SOFTEE WINNER STAR PRO is a hybrid format racket, between round and teardrop. This mold generates high control and very good thrust. In its composition, the 3K carbon and the new S9 rubber from Softee Padel stand out.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, the SOFTEE WINNER STAR PRO is one of the Softee padel rackets that can give us the best sensations thanks to its soft S9 EVA and its hybrid format.

products.title: Vibora Russell Advance - Vibora
products.description:
VIBORA RUSSELL ADVANCE - The design is unique. High-end Vibora padel racket, with spectacular quality, with a very premium finish and made entirely of carbon, both flat and frame. INTRODUCTION OF PALA

If your thing is to have padel rackets with striking designs, with the new VIBORA RUSSELL ADVANCE you will achieve it. It is a racket that can be seen from afar, with a strong black and orange design.

TYPE OF PLAYERS

It is created for a balanced player, at an intermediate-advanced level who wants to get out of a quality padel racket and is already looking for something better with which to continue improving.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Vibora Padel leaves us jewels like this. The new VIBORA RUSSELL ADVANCE is one of the most beautiful Vibora rackets.

Its shape is teardrop, and it comes in a balanced and medium weight between 360-370 grams.

The quality is noticeable throughout the racket. It is made entirely of 3K carbon fiber. This material is found throughout the entire racket, and offers us the best relationship between power, control, resistance and, above all, lightness, since it is the lightest fiber available for padel rackets.

Its core consists of an Eva rubber.

PLAY STYLE

On the court, the VIBORA RUSSELL ADVANCE racket works wonderfully, since we will feel safe both from the baseline or from the net. Versatility is one of its best attributes.
